$comment: The report a smoke run produces when it never navigates: 34 served, 33 openable, 0 opened, 0 errors. Kept as the mutant control -- the verdict must FAIL it (face v2 Phase 00). A gate that only counted errors would call this clean. Carries a mood (face v2 Phase 01) with an empty miss list, so the refusal it proves is the opened=0 one and not a missing mood.
